notes: All products, screens and copy are fictional and written for this eval set. 'checks' is a machine-gradable mirror of 'assertions' used by evals/grade.py (regex over the output text). 'manual' checks are graded by a human/LLM reviewer and recorded with evidence.

evals.name: ios-settings-review
evals.prompt: 帮我按苹果的标准审一下我们 iOS 健身 App「Stride」的设置页：一屏平铺 18 个开关，没有分组；标签写的是「Enable 心率提醒」「启用 GPS 增强（实验性）」；每个开关下面有 12pt Light 灰色说明；右上角有个 30×30pt 的「保存」按钮，不点保存直接返回会丢改动；要定位权限时写的是「请前往 设置>隐私>定位服务 开启」。给问题清单和改法。
evals.expected_output: 按 P0/P1/P2 分级的问题表，引用 iOS 口径（44pt 触控、动态字体、最小字号、细字重），给分组/渐进披露、即时生效、标签与说明改写、权限直达按钮，并给改后文案。
assertions: Uses a prioritized issue list (P0/P1/P2 or equivalent severity)
Flags the 30pt save button against the 44×44pt iOS minimum
Flags 12pt Light gray text (thin weight / Dynamic Type / contrast)
Proposes grouping + progressive disclosure for 18 toggles
Proposes changes apply immediately (remove Save)
Rewrites 'Enable/启用' as 打开/关闭 and removes mixed-language labels
Replaces the manual settings path with a direct 'Open Settings/前往设置' button
Gives concrete rewritten label/description copy

patterns: 即时生效|立即生效|去掉.{0,4}保存|删掉.{0,4}保存
前往设置|打开设置|Open Settings

evals.name: web-landing-hero
evals.prompt: Can you review the hero of our marketing site for Lingo (an AI meeting-translation SaaS) and make it feel more Apple? Current hero: headline 'The Next-Generation AI-Powered Omnichannel Translation Platform Empowering Global Enterprises'; two equally loud buttons 'Start Free Trial' and 'Book a Demo'; an auto-playing carousel of 5 slides that never stops; body text #A0A0A0 on white at 13px; icon-only social links that are 18×18 px. It's a website, not an app.
evals.expected_output: Web-specific review: one primary CTA, benefit-led short headline with plain subhead, removes buzzwords, carousel pause/stop (WCAG 2.2.2), contrast 4.5:1 for body text, target size 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), accessible names for icon links, and rewritten copy options.
assertions: Treats it as a web/marketing (persuade) surface, using CSS px / WCAG, not iOS pt
Recommends one primary CTA and a secondary link
Rewrites the headline into a short, benefit-led line plus a plain subhead (at least 2 options)
Flags the auto-playing carousel and requires pause/stop or removal
Flags #A0A0A0 body text contrast against 4.5:1
Flags 18px icon targets against 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8)
Requires accessible names/labels for icon-only links

evals.name: web-tool-asset-library
evals.prompt: 我们在做一个给小型印刷工作室用的 Web 资产管理工具「Crate」（模板、字体、客户 Logo 都是资产，订单会引用这些资产）。现在的问题我列一下，你按苹果式标准帮我做个审查：1）首页「最近动态」是开发时写死的示例数据；2）资产列表顶部写「共 128 个」，但筛选后表格空了，页码还显示 1/13；3）「全部删除」按钮红色，紧挨着「导出」，点了直接删；4）导出 2GB 素材包时按钮转圈，没有进度，刷新后不知道还在不在跑；5）每次导出扣「点数」，但页面上看不到会扣多少；6）同一个东西有时叫「素材」有时叫「资产」有时叫「文件」；7）官网写「免费注册即可使用」，注册页却写「仅限邀请」；8）模板卡片显示「0 次引用」，但其实有 6 个订单在用；9）普通成员能看到「删除工作区」按钮，点了才提示没权限。
evals.expected_output: 按工具类（Operate）口径分级审查：数据真实、计数与分页一致、危险操作（确认+撤销/回收站+影响范围）、长任务（进度+后台+可恢复+完成通知）、计费透明、术语表、承诺与能力一致、引用关系可见可跳转、权限前置隐藏或说明；Web 无障碍口径；给改后界面文案。
assertions: Identifies the surface as an operational tool and prioritizes truthfulness/task completion over visual polish
Removes hardcoded demo data (real data or honest empty state)
Fixes count/pagination consistency after filtering
Danger zone: separates delete-all from export, confirmation naming scope, undo or trash/recovery
Long-running export: visible progress, survives refresh/background, completion notice
Billing transparency: show cost before action and a usage record
Proposes a glossary (one term per concept)
Aligns marketing promise with actual signup availability
Shows accurate asset reference counts with links to referencing orders, warns before deleting referenced assets
Permissions: hide or disable-with-reason before click
Uses a severity-ranked table and gives rewritten UI copy

patterns: 写死|示例数据|假数据|真实数据
用量记录|消费记录|消耗多少|将消耗
跳转|点开|链接|列出|查看|点击看到
权限.{0,20}(隐藏|置灰|不显示|说明原因)|(隐藏|不显示).{0,20}权限

evals.name: empty-error-dialog-notification-copy
evals.prompt: Write the UI copy (Chinese and English) for our photo backup app 'Tidal': (a) empty state of the Albums tab for a new user, (b) upload failed because the network dropped — photos are still safe on the phone, (c) confirmation dialog for deleting an album that contains 240 photos (photos stay in the library, only the album goes away), (d) a push notification when a backup of 1,200 photos finishes. Current drafts are: 'Oops! Nothing here yet~', 'Error 503: Upload failed. Please try again later.', 'Are you sure? [Yes] [No]', 'Tidal: Task completed successfully!'
evals.expected_output: Copy for all four states in both languages; no Oops/apology/error codes up front; error says what happened, data safety, next step; dialog title asks the specific question, buttons are specific verbs with destructive marked, explains consequence (photos stay); notification states result concretely; no 'we'.
assertions: Covers all four states (a-d) in both Chinese and English
Empty state explains how content will appear and offers one action
Error removes the code/Oops, reassures photos are safe and gives a next step (auto-retry or retry)
Dialog uses specific action buttons (e.g. Delete Album / Cancel) instead of Yes/No and states photos remain in library
Notification states the concrete result (1,200 photos) without exclamation filler
Does not use 'we/我们' in UI copy

patterns: still on (your|this) (phone|iPhone|device)|safe on|仍在手机|还在手机|安全
stay in|remain in|留在|仍在.{0,4}(图库|照片)

evals.name: keynote-and-product-page-hero
evals.prompt: 我们下个月发布一款桌面智能台灯「Halo」。参数：自动跟随环境光调色温 2700–6500K、无频闪、坐姿提醒、APP 远程控制、续航（电池版）12 小时、重 800g、6 项专利、获设计奖。帮我写：1）产品页首屏（中英文）；2）发布会开场 3 分钟的结构和关键台词。别堆参数。
evals.expected_output: Hero with clever headline + plain subhead + one CTA in both languages (transcreated, not translated); keynote structure: tension line → rule of three or single story → demo per point → one big number with footnote → return to opening → one more thing → price/availability; parameters moved to evidence/spec; no unprovable superlatives.
assertions: Hero has a short headline, a plain subhead and one CTA
Provides both Chinese and English hero, transcreated rather than literally translated
Keynote opening has a tension/problem line, a small number of key points, a demo per point
Uses exactly one hero number with a conditions footnote
Moves specs (6 patents, 800g, award) out of the hero into evidence/spec
Avoids unprovable superlatives (最/第一/best)

patterns: 规格页|放到.{0,6}(后面|最后|规格)|证据|spec
最强|第一款|全球首|best ever|world's best

evals.name: localization-transcreation
evals.prompt: Our English site for the travel mug 'Thermo' uses these lines. Please localize them for the mainland China site (not translate) and explain each choice: 1) 'Hot take. Cold brew.' 2) 'The world's best travel mug.' 3) 'Keeps coffee hot for 12 hours.¹' 4) Button: 'Get yours'.
evals.expected_output: Chinese transcreations that rebuild the wordplay with Chinese devices (对仗/四字格/同字), replace the unprovable superlative per 广告法 with a provable claim, keep number with footnote and add Chinese-English spacing rules, and render the button as a clear verb (购买/选购).
assertions: Explains it is transcreation and rebuilds pun with a Chinese rhetorical device
Removes 'world's best' for China citing advertising-law superlative restrictions and substitutes a provable claim
Keeps the 12-hour number with footnote/test conditions
Button becomes a clear Chinese verb
Mentions spacing between Chinese and Latin/numbers

patterns: 对仗|四字|同字|双关|谐音|parallel|pun
广告法|极限词|最高级|Advertising Law|superlative
购买|选购|立即购买|买一个

evals.name: cross-platform-specs
evals.prompt: 我们同一套设计要同时出 iOS App 和 Web 版（React）。设计师问：按钮最小多大？正文用多大字号？对比度要求多少？要不要做减弱动效？焦点样式怎么定？请分别给 iOS 和 Web 的标准，并注明依据。
evals.expected_output: A mapping table: iOS 44×44pt (HIG) vs Web 24×24 CSS px AA minimum (WCAG 2.5.8) with 44×44 as AAA/recommended; body 17pt iOS vs ~16px web base (convention, not WCAG requirement); contrast 4.5:1/3:1 for both (WCAG 1.4.3), non-text 3:1 (1.4.11); Reduce Motion vs prefers-reduced-motion (2.3.3 AAA); focus visible (2.4.7) and focus not obscured (2.4.11); cites sources and flags what is convention vs requirement.
assertions: Gives separate iOS and Web values in a mapping
Web target size cites WCAG 2.5.8 24×24 CSS px (AA) and distinguishes 44×44 (2.5.5 AAA)
Contrast 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large text, and 3:1 for UI components
Maps Reduce Motion to prefers-reduced-motion
Covers focus visible / not obscured on web
Distinguishes hard requirements from conventions and cites sources

grading_changelog: iteration-1 (after first baseline read-through): widened 5 regexes that produced false negatives on wording variants (headline-options, billing, count-pagination, promise, references) and excluded meta-commentary lines from regex_none checks. Changed before any new-skill output existed. Also added English synonyms to the 3 localization checks so English-language answers are not penalized.
